//! The engine against the Lean model (LLP 3000.035 §5.2).
//!
//! **The model side.** Each case's surface program goes through
//! `snapback4_lang::emit::lean` (the parsed tree, never the binder's IR) to
//! the model's case JSON, and through `quarry-oracle` (`snapback4/lean`,
//! `lake build`), one long-lived process per worker that answers one tagged
//! outcome per line. A case the emitter cannot translate is `Unsupported`
//! under the emitter's named reason, never a pass.
//!
//! **The engine side.** The engine over SQLite (the ordinary in-memory
//! server store) at `Ceilings::default()`, the ceilings a production server
//! runs, not the case's stored budget; the model runs unbounded (its meter is
//! abstract, OPEN M1).
//!
//! **Compared fields** (README, "How the harness compares"):
//!
//! - `kind`: answer, unavailable, refused, committed;
//! - `code`: the refusal code (sites are not modelled);
//! - `data` / `result`: exact, both sides as tagged values, so an id never
//!   compares equal to a text (OPEN V1); rows compare as field maps;
//! - `complete`: exact;
//! - `next`: presence only (OPEN C1). When both carry one, each side
//!   continues from its own cursor and the next page is compared
//!   (`continuation-*`), until both are exhausted;
//! - a mutation then runs `observe` on each side's resulting store
//!   (`post-*`): the engine's store, and the model's committed store (or the
//!   original store after a refusal).
//!
//! Meter fields, cut sites, `tables` and `seq` are not compared. Expiry
//! sweeps advance both stores before the following program is compared.
//!
//! **Signatures** are `lean--{field}--{engine}~{model}`, each side's stable
//! class (a refusal code, `unavailable`, `committed`, or the data's shape).
//! The finding's `left` is the engine's raw record, `right` the model's raw
//! outcome; the canonical forms compared are its `continuation`.
// @ref LLP 3000.035#52-stage-2-a-small-lean-core — the Lean model as a further oracle over the Stage 1 generator.
use crate::{
    ast::Body,
    campaign::Report,
    execute::{self, Outcome},
    generate::Case,
    oracle::{Finding, Oracle, Verdict},
};
use serde_json::{Map, Value as Json, json};
use snapback4_core::Ceilings;
use snapback4_lang::emit::lean::LeanModule;
use std::{
    cell::RefCell,
    collections::BTreeSet,
    fs::{self, OpenOptions},
    io::{BufRead, BufReader, Write},
    path::PathBuf,
    process::{Child, ChildStdin, ChildStdout, Command, Stdio},
};

/// The `quarry-oracle` executable: `SNAPBACK4_LEAN_ORACLE`, else the Lake
/// build in this checkout.
pub fn oracle_path() -> PathBuf {
    match std::env::var_os("SNAPBACK4_LEAN_ORACLE") {
        Some(p) => PathBuf::from(p),
        None => PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../lean/.lake/build/bin/quarry-oracle"),
    }
}

/// Bring this checkout's `quarry-oracle` up to date with its model sources
/// (`lake build quarry-oracle`, under a second when current). A merge or
/// checkout that changes `lean/` leaves the previous executable in `.lake`,
/// and the harness would report that older model's choices as disagreements
/// (2026-10-12: a stale pre-guard oracle on the merged `sb4-loop` tree showed
/// `lean--complete--complete~incomplete`). Nothing is done when
/// `SNAPBACK4_LEAN_ORACLE` names the oracle (the caller vouches for it; a
/// campaign's workers inherit the refreshed path that way) or when `lake` is
/// not installed (a missing oracle still refuses at `LeanProcess::spawn`).
pub fn refresh() -> Result<(), String> {
    if std::env::var_os("SNAPBACK4_LEAN_ORACLE").is_some() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../lean");
    // Keep the optional-tool path read-only, including a checkout whose model
    // directory is not writable. A version probe writes no Lake build artifacts.
    match Command::new("lake").arg("--version").current_dir(&dir).stdin(Stdio::null()).output() {
        Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
            eprintln!("lake not found: using the Lean oracle as built at {}", oracle_path().display());
            return Ok(());
        }
        Err(e) => return Err(format!("lake: {e}")),
        Ok(_) => {} // The build below reports actual toolchain/configuration errors.
    }
    // @ref LLP 3000.035#52-stage-2-a-small-lean-core — concurrent refreshes must not write the same Lake artifacts.
    let cache = dir.join(".lake");
    fs::create_dir_all(&cache).map_err(|e| format!("Lean refresh cache: {e}"))?;
    let refresh_lock = OpenOptions::new().create(true).truncate(false).read(true).write(true)
        .open(cache.join("snapback4-refresh.lock")).map_err(|e| format!("Lean refresh lock: {e}"))?;
    refresh_lock.lock().map_err(|e| format!("Lean refresh lock: {e}"))?;
    match Command::new("lake").args(["build", "quarry-oracle"]).current_dir(&dir).stdin(Stdio::null()).output() {
        Ok(output) if output.status.success() => Ok(()),
        Ok(output) => Err(format!(
            "`lake build quarry-oracle` failed in {}: {}{}",
            dir.display(),
            String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),
            String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
        )),
        Err(e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
            eprintln!("lake not found: using the Lean oracle as built at {}", oracle_path().display());
            Ok(())
        }
        Err(e) => Err(format!("lake: {e}")),
    }
}

/// One `quarry-oracle` process: a JSON case per line in, an outcome per line out.
pub struct LeanProcess {
    child: Child,
    stdin: ChildStdin,
    stdout: BufReader<ChildStdout>,
}
impl LeanProcess {
    pub fn spawn() -> Result<Self, String> {
        let path = oracle_path();
        if !path.is_file() {
            return Err(format!(
                "Lean oracle missing: {} (run `cd snapback4/lean && lake build`, or set SNAPBACK4_LEAN_ORACLE)",
                path.display()
            ));
        }
        let mut child = Command::new(&path)
            .stdin(Stdio::piped())
            .stdout(Stdio::piped())
            .stderr(Stdio::inherit())
            .spawn()
            .map_err(|e| format!("Lean oracle {}: {e}", path.display()))?;
        let stdin = child.stdin.take().unwrap();
        let stdout = BufReader::new(child.stdout.take().unwrap());
        Ok(Self { child, stdin, stdout })
    }
    pub fn ask(&mut self, case: &Json) -> Result<Json, String> {
        writeln!(self.stdin, "{case}").map_err(|e| format!("Lean oracle write: {e}"))?;
        self.stdin.flush().map_err(|e| format!("Lean oracle flush: {e}"))?;
        let mut line = String::new();
        let n = self.stdout.read_line(&mut line).map_err(|e| format!("Lean oracle read: {e}"))?;
        if n == 0 {
            return Err("Lean oracle exited".into());
        }
        let answer: Json = serde_json::from_str(&line).map_err(|e| format!("Lean oracle answer {line:?}: {e}"))?;
        if answer["kind"] == "error" {
            // A case the model cannot decode is an emitter defect, never a verdict.
            return Err(format!("Lean oracle refused the case: {}", answer["error"]));
        }
        Ok(answer)
    }
}
impl Drop for LeanProcess {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let _ = self.child.kill();
        let _ = self.child.wait();
    }
}

thread_local! {
    static PROCESS: RefCell<Option<LeanProcess>> = const { RefCell::new(None) };
}

/// Ask this thread's oracle process, starting it on first use and once
/// more if it has died.
pub fn ask(case: &Json) -> Result<Json, String> {
    PROCESS.with(|cell| {
        let mut slot = cell.borrow_mut();
        if slot.is_none() {
            *slot = Some(LeanProcess::spawn()?);
        }
        match slot.as_mut().unwrap().ask(case) {
            Err(e) if e == "Lean oracle exited" => {
                *slot = Some(LeanProcess::spawn()?);
                slot.as_mut().unwrap().ask(case)
            }
            other => other,
        }
    })
}

/// The engine's value as the model's tagged value; rows as field maps.
pub fn engine_value(v: &snapback4_core::Value) -> Json {
    use snapback4_core::Value as V;
    match v {
        V::Null => json!({"null": null}),
        V::Bool(b) => json!({"bool": b}),
        V::Int(n) => json!({"int": n.to_string()}),
        V::String(s) => json!({"text": s}),
        V::Id(s) => json!({"id": s}),
        V::Bytes(b) => json!({"bytes": b.iter().map(|x| format!("{x:02x}")).collect::<String>()}),
        V::Row(fs) | V::Map(fs) => json!({"row": fs.iter().map(|(k, x)| (k.clone(), engine_value(x))).collect::<Map<_, _>>()}),
        V::Array(xs) => json!({"arr": xs.iter().map(engine_value).collect::<Vec<_>>()}),
    }
}

/// The model's tagged value with rows as field maps (its rows are ordered pairs).
pub fn model_value(v: &Json) -> Json {
    if let Some(xs) = v.get("arr").and_then(Json::as_array) {
        return json!({"arr": xs.iter().map(model_value).collect::<Vec<_>>()});
    }
    if let Some(fs) = v.get("row").and_then(Json::as_array) {
        let mut m = Map::new();
        for p in fs {
            m.insert(p[0].as_str().unwrap_or_default().to_owned(), model_value(&p[1]));
        }
        return json!({"row": m});
    }
    v.clone()
}

fn shape(v: &Json) -> String {
    v.as_object().and_then(|o| o.keys().next().cloned()).unwrap_or_else(|| "value".into())
}

/// One side's comparable record: `kind`, then `code` or `data`/`complete`/`next`.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct Canon {
    pub kind: String,
    pub code: Option<String>,
    pub data: Option<Json>,
    pub complete: Option<bool>,
    pub next: bool,
}
impl Canon {
    /// The side's stable class for a differing `field`: the field's own
    /// value where it is a flag, else a code, kind or data shape.
    pub fn class(&self, field: &str) -> String {
        if field.ends_with("complete") {
            return if self.complete == Some(true) { "complete" } else { "incomplete" }.into();
        }
        if field.ends_with("next") {
            return if self.next { "next" } else { "no-next" }.into();
        }
        match (&self.code, &self.data) {
            (Some(code), _) => code.clone(),
            (None, Some(d)) if self.kind == "answer" => shape(d),
            _ => self.kind.clone(),
        }
    }
    fn json(&self) -> Json {
        json!({"kind": self.kind, "code": self.code, "data": self.data, "complete": self.complete, "next": self.next})
    }
}

pub fn engine_canon(o: &Outcome) -> Canon {
    let blank = Canon { kind: String::new(), code: None, data: None, complete: None, next: false };
    if let Some(r) = o.refusal() {
        return Canon { kind: "refused".into(), code: r["code"].as_str().map(str::to_owned), ..blank };
    }
    if o.kind == "mutation" {
        let result = serde_json::from_value::<snapback4_core::Value>(o.value["result"].clone()).map(|v| engine_value(&v)).unwrap_or(Json::Null);
        return Canon { kind: "committed".into(), data: Some(result), ..blank };
    }
    if o.value.get("unavailable") == Some(&json!(true)) {
        return Canon { kind: "unavailable".into(), ..blank };
    }
    let data = serde_json::from_value::<snapback4_core::Value>(o.value["data"].clone()).map(|v| engine_value(&v)).unwrap_or(Json::Null);
    Canon { kind: "answer".into(), data: Some(data), complete: o.value["complete"].as_bool(), next: o.next().is_some(), ..blank }
}

pub fn model_canon(m: &Json) -> Canon {
    let blank = Canon { kind: m["kind"].as_str().unwrap_or("error").to_owned(), code: None, data: None, complete: None, next: false };
    match blank.kind.as_str() {
        "refused" => Canon { code: m["code"].as_str().map(str::to_owned), ..blank },
        "committed" => Canon { data: Some(model_value(&m["result"])), ..blank },
        "answer" => Canon {
            data: Some(model_value(&m["data"])),
            complete: m["complete"].as_bool(),
            next: m["next"] != json!({"null": null}),
            ..blank
        },
        _ => blank,
    }
}

/// The first differing field, in the order a reader wants it.
pub fn differ(e: &Canon, m: &Canon) -> Option<&'static str> {
    if e.kind != m.kind {
        return Some("kind");
    }
    if e.code != m.code {
        return Some("code");
    }
    if e.data != m.data {
        return Some(if e.kind == "committed" { "result" } else { "data" });
    }
    if e.complete != m.complete {
        return Some("complete");
    }
    if e.next != m.next {
        return Some("next");
    }
    None
}

/// `lean--{field}--{engine class}~{model class}`.
pub fn signature(field: &str, e: &Canon, m: &Canon) -> String {
    format!("lean--{}--{}~{}", field.replace('_', "-"), e.class(field), m.class(field))
}

fn finding(field: &str, e: &Canon, m: &Canon, engine: Outcome, model: &Json, trail: Vec<Outcome>) -> Verdict {
    Verdict::Disagree(Finding {
        signature: signature(field, e, m),
        oracle: Oracle::Lean,
        field: field.into(),
        left: engine,
        right: Outcome { kind: "lean".into(), value: model.clone() },
        continuation: trail,
        store_trace: None,
    })
}

fn trail_entry(e: &Canon, m: &Canon) -> Outcome {
    Outcome { kind: "canonical".into(), value: json!({"engine": e.json(), "model": m.json()}) }
}

/// What one case comes to; `executed` counts engine and model calls.
pub struct Checked {
    pub verdict: Verdict,
    pub executed: u64,
    pub pages: u64,
    pub mutation: bool,
    /// The first outcome's class on an agreeing case (`committed`, a code,
    /// `unavailable`, or the data's shape).
    pub class: String,
}

/// The module, or why the case is outside the fragment.
pub fn module(source: &str) -> Result<LeanModule, String> {
    match snapback4_lang::emit::lean::lean(&[("schema.q".into(), source.into())]) {
        Ok(module) => Ok(module),
        Err(snapback4_lang::emit::lean::LeanError::Diagnostics(_)) => Err("parse".into()),
        Err(snapback4_lang::emit::lean::LeanError::Unsupported(u)) => Err(u.reason),
    }
}

/// Compare one case whose source compiles. `Err` is a harness or emitter
/// defect (never a verdict).
pub fn compare(case: &Case, source: &str) -> Result<Checked, String> {
    let unsupported = |reason: String| Ok(Checked { verdict: Verdict::Unsupported(reason), executed: 0, pages: 0, mutation: false, class: String::new() });
    let module = match module(source) {
        Ok(m) => m,
        Err(reason) => return unsupported(reason),
    };
    let mutation = case.program.mutation();
    if let Err(u) = module.program("run") {
        return unsupported(u.reason);
    }
    if mutation {
        if let Err(u) = module.program("observe") {
            return unsupported(format!("observe-{}", u.reason));
        }
    }
    let store = match module.store(&case.rows) {
        Ok(s) => s,
        Err(u) => return unsupported(u.reason),
    };
    let mut m_args = match module.tag_args("run", &case.args) {
        Ok(a) => a,
        Err(u) => return unsupported(u.reason),
    };
    // The prelude: each step on the engine and on the model's store, in order.
    for i in 0..case.steps.len() {
        if let Err(u) = module.program(&format!("prep{i}")) {
            return unsupported(format!("prelude-{}", u.reason));
        }
        if let Err(u) = module.tag_args(&format!("prep{i}"), &case.steps[i].args) {
            return unsupported(format!("prelude-{}", u.reason));
        }
    }
    let (mut engine, prelude) = execute::world(case, source)?;
    engine.set_ceilings(Ceilings::default());
    let mut executed = 0;
    let mut pages = 0;
    let mut store = store;
    let mut sweep_cursor: Option<Json> = None;
    let mut steps = prelude.iter();
    let mut trail = vec![];
    for (i, step) in case.steps.iter().enumerate() {
        let name = format!("prep{i}");
        if step.sweep {
            let e_sweep = steps.next().ok_or("prelude sweep outcome missing")?;
            if e_sweep.kind != "sweep" || e_sweep.value.get("error").is_some() {
                return Err(format!("engine prelude sweep failed: {:?}", e_sweep.value));
            }
            let args = module.tag_args(&name, &step.args).map_err(|u| u.to_string())?;
            let viewer = step.viewer.as_deref().unwrap_or(&case.principal);
            let mut sweep_case = module.case_at_sweep(&name, store.clone(), viewer, args, None, step.at, true).map_err(|u| u.to_string())?;
            sweep_case["sweepLimit"] = json!(10_000);
            if let Some(cursor) = &sweep_cursor { sweep_case["sweepCursor"] = cursor.clone(); }
            let swept = ask(&sweep_case)?;
            executed += 1;
            if swept["kind"] != "committed" { return Err(format!("Lean prelude sweep failed: {swept}")); }
            store = swept["store"].clone();
            sweep_cursor = Some(swept["result"].clone());
        }
        let e_raw = steps.next().ok_or("prelude outcome missing")?.clone();
        let args = module.tag_args(&name, &step.args).map_err(|u| u.to_string())?;
        let viewer = step.viewer.as_deref().unwrap_or(&case.principal);
        let m_raw = ask(&module.case_at(&name, store.clone(), viewer, args, None, step.at).map_err(|u| u.to_string())?)?;
        executed += 2;
        let (e, m) = (engine_canon(&e_raw), model_canon(&m_raw));
        trail.push(trail_entry(&e, &m));
        if let Some(f) = differ(&e, &m) {
            return Ok(Checked { verdict: finding(&format!("prelude-{f}"), &e, &m, e_raw, &m_raw, trail), executed, pages, mutation, class: String::new() });
        }
        if m.kind == "committed" {
            store = m_raw["store"].clone();
        }
    }
    if case.sweep {
        let e_sweep = steps.next().ok_or("final sweep outcome missing")?;
        if e_sweep.kind != "sweep" || e_sweep.value.get("error").is_some() {
            return Err(format!("engine final sweep failed: {:?}", e_sweep.value));
        }
        let mut sweep_case = module.case_at_sweep("run", store.clone(), &case.principal, m_args.clone(), None, case.clock, true).map_err(|u| u.to_string())?;
        sweep_case["sweepLimit"] = json!(10_000);
        if let Some(cursor) = &sweep_cursor { sweep_case["sweepCursor"] = cursor.clone(); }
        let swept = ask(&sweep_case)?;
        executed += 1;
        if swept["kind"] != "committed" { return Err(format!("Lean final sweep failed: {swept}")); }
        store = swept["store"].clone();
    }
    if mutation {
        let e_raw = execute::execute(&mut engine, case, "run", &case.args);
        let m_raw = ask(&module.case_at("run", store.clone(), &case.principal, m_args, None, case.clock).map_err(|u| u.to_string())?)?;
        executed += 2;
        let (e, m) = (engine_canon(&e_raw), model_canon(&m_raw));
        let first_class = e.class("kind");
        let mut trail = vec![trail_entry(&e, &m)];
        if let Some(f) = differ(&e, &m) {
            return Ok(Checked { verdict: finding(f, &e, &m, e_raw, &m_raw, trail), executed, pages, mutation, class: String::new() });
        }
        // The resulting stores, seen through `observe`.
        let after = if m.kind == "committed" { m_raw["store"].clone() } else { store };
        let o_args = module.tag_args("observe", &case.args).map_err(|u| u.to_string())?;
        let eo_raw = execute::execute(&mut engine, case, "observe", &case.args);
        let mo_raw = ask(&module.case_at("observe", after, &case.principal, o_args, None, case.clock).map_err(|u| u.to_string())?)?;
        executed += 2;
        let (eo, mo) = (engine_canon(&eo_raw), model_canon(&mo_raw));
        trail.push(trail_entry(&eo, &mo));
        if let Some(f) = differ(&eo, &mo) {
            return Ok(Checked { verdict: finding(&format!("post-{f}"), &eo, &mo, eo_raw, &mo_raw, trail), executed, pages, mutation, class: String::new() });
        }
        return Ok(Checked { verdict: Verdict::Pass, executed, pages, mutation, class: format!("{}-{}", if mutation { "mutation" } else { "query" }, first_class) });
    }
    let mut e_args = case.args.clone();
    let mut trail = Vec::new();
    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut first_class = String::new();
    loop {
        let e_raw = execute::execute(&mut engine, case, "run", &e_args);
        let m_raw = ask(&module.case_at("run", store.clone(), &case.principal, m_args.clone(), None, case.clock).map_err(|u| u.to_string())?)?;
        executed += 2;
        pages += 1;
        let (e, m) = (engine_canon(&e_raw), model_canon(&m_raw));
        if pages == 1 {
            first_class = e.class("kind");
        }
        trail.push(trail_entry(&e, &m));
        let phase = if pages > 1 { "continuation-" } else { "" };
        if let Some(f) = differ(&e, &m) {
            return Ok(Checked { verdict: finding(&format!("{phase}{f}"), &e, &m, e_raw, &m_raw, trail), executed, pages, mutation, class: String::new() });
        }
        if !e.next {
            break;
        }
        let next = e_raw.next().unwrap().to_owned();
        if !seen.insert(next.clone()) || seen.len() > case.rows.len() + 2 {
            return Ok(Checked { verdict: finding("cursor-cycle", &e, &m, e_raw, &m_raw, trail), executed, pages, mutation, class: String::new() });
        }
        e_args["c"] = json!(next);
        m_args.insert("c".into(), m_raw["next"].clone());
    }
    Ok(Checked { verdict: Verdict::Pass, executed, pages, mutation, class: format!("query-{first_class}") })
}

/// The open points a case can exercise (`snapback4/lean/OPEN.md`), counted
/// over compared cases so a report shows each point's evidence.
pub fn features(case: &Case) -> Vec<String> {
    use crate::ast::{Read, Rule, Write};
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    out.extend(crate::generate::page4_features(case));
    out.extend(crate::generate::page5_features(case));
    let items = &case.program.tables[0];
    let rules: Vec<Rule> = items.effects.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| vec![items.rule.clone(); 4]);
    let access_hidden = case.program.tables.get(1).and_then(|t| t.effects.as_ref()).is_some_and(|e| e[0] == Rule::Deny);
    let body = &case.program.body;
    let write = match body {
        Body::Write(w, _) => Some(w),
        _ => None,
    };
    if items.effects.is_some() {
        out.push("items-effect-rules".into());
    }
    // LLP 3000.036.001: branch pages (the merged plan is decided by OPEN C8's branch rule).
    let where_branch = case.program.domain.as_deref().is_some_and(|domain| domain.contains(" or "));
    if let Some(domain) = case.program.domain.as_ref().filter(|_| where_branch) {
        out.push(format!("branch-where-{}", if domain.contains("helper") { "parties" } else { "buckets" }));
    }
    if rules[0] == Rule::TwoParty {
        out.push("branch-rule-two-party".into());
    }
    let membership_branch = matches!(rules[0], Rule::OwnerOrWitness | Rule::OwnerOrIdWitness)
        && matches!(body, Body::Read { kind: Read::Page | Read::Bounded, owner: false, .. });
    if membership_branch {
        out.push("branch-rule-membership".into());
        if rules[0] == Rule::OwnerOrIdWitness {
            out.push("branch-rule-membership-id".into());
        }
        if case.program.tables.iter().find(|table| table.name == "access").is_some_and(|table| table.caps.is_empty()) {
            out.push("branch-rule-membership-uncapped".into());
        }
        if case.program.membership_named_reordered {
            out.push("branch-rule-membership-named-reordered".into());
        }
        if case.program.tables.iter().find(|table| table.name == "access").is_some_and(|table|
            table.keys.iter().any(|(_, columns, unique)| *unique && columns.iter().map(String::as_str).eq(["principal"]))
                && table.columns.iter().any(|column| column.name == "bucket" && matches!(column.ty, crate::ast::Type::Nullable(_)))) {
            out.push("branch-rule-membership-discovery-unique".into());
        }
    }
    let boolean_grant = case.program.boolean_grant_normalized
        && matches!(body, Body::Read { kind: Read::Page | Read::Bounded, owner: false, .. });
    if boolean_grant {
        out.push("branch-rule-boolean-grant".into());
    }
    if where_branch || rules[0] == Rule::TwoParty || membership_branch || boolean_grant {
        let bound = snapback4_lang::compile(&[("schema.q".into(), case.program.source())]);
        let merged = bound.programs.iter().filter(|p| p.program.name == "run")
            .any(|p| snapback4_core::search_plan::merges(&p.program.body).iter().any(|m| m.branches()));
        out.push(format!("branch-{}", if merged { "merged" } else { "single-index" }));
}

    // @ref LLP 3000.039#9 — run-lean reports supported action cases by action (and, with `kind`, outcome).
    if let Some(kids) = &case.program.kids {
        let action = kids.action.as_deref().unwrap_or("undeclared").replace(' ', "-");
        let deletes = matches!(body, Body::Write(Write::Delete, _)) || case.program.prelude.iter().chain(match body { Body::Block(b) => Some(b), _ => None })
            .flat_map(|b| b.all()).any(|s| matches!(s, crate::ast::Stmt::Write { kind: Write::Delete, .. }));
        out.push(format!("references-{action}{}", if deletes { "-delete" } else { "" }));
        if kids.notes { out.push("references-restricting-notes".into()); }
    }
    // Widened shapes (`widen.rs`) inside the model's fragment.
    if matches!(body, Body::Block(_)) {
        out.push("block".into());
    }
    if !case.program.prelude.is_empty() {
        out.push(format!("prelude-{}-steps", case.program.prelude.len()));
        if case.steps.iter().any(|s| s.viewer.is_some()) {
            out.push("prelude-other-viewer".into());
        }
    }
    let blocks = case.program.prelude.iter().chain(match body {
        Body::Block(b) => Some(b),
        _ => None,
    });
    let stmts: Vec<_> = blocks.flat_map(|b| b.all()).collect();
    if stmts.iter().filter(|s| matches!(s, crate::ast::Stmt::Write { .. })).count() > 1 {
        out.push("multi-write".into());
    }
    if stmts.iter().any(|s| matches!(s, crate::ast::Stmt::Write { kind: Write::Insert | Write::Upsert, tag, .. } if tag == "tag0" || tag == "tag1")) {
        out.push("unique-tag-clash-candidate".into());
    }
    if let Some(w) = write {
        let rule = match w {
            Write::Insert => &rules[1],
            Write::Upsert | Write::Update => &rules[2],
            Write::Delete => &rules[3],
        };
        out.push(format!("write-{w:?}-under-{rule:?}").to_lowercase());
        if matches!(w, Write::Upsert | Write::Update) && rules[0] != Rule::Allow {
            out.push(format!("write-{w:?}-readable-by-{:?}", rules[0]).to_lowercase());
        }
    }
    if matches!(rules[0], Rule::PureIdWitness | Rule::CompoundGrant | Rule::CompoundMembership | Rule::RoleGrant) || rules[0] == Rule::Witness && case.program.domain.as_deref() == Some("true") { out.push(format!("page3-{:?}", rules[0]).to_lowercase()); }
    if rules[0] == Rule::OwnerOrGrant && case.program.domain.as_deref().is_some_and(|d| d.contains("exists access")) { out.push("page3-static-predicate".into()); }
    if rules[0] == Rule::OwnerOrGrant {
        out.push("read-grant".into());
    }
    if let Some(guard) = &case.program.guard {
        out.push(format!("where-guard-{}", match guard.as_str() {
            "exists access[bucket, viewer]" => "probe",
            "not exists access[bucket, viewer]" => "not-probe",
            _ => "arguments",
        }));
    }
    let probing = |r: &Rule| matches!(r, Rule::Witness | Rule::OwnerOrWitness | Rule::OwnerOrIdWitness);
    if access_hidden && rules.iter().any(probing) {
        out.push("probe-of-hidden-access".into());
    }
    if let Body::Read { kind, owner, .. } = body {
        let uniform = match rules[0] {
            Rule::Owner | Rule::OwnerOrGrant => *owner,
            // The witness disjunct is pinned by `.bucket`: decided per caller (§16.3).
            Rule::OwnerOrWitness | Rule::OwnerOrIdWitness => *owner,
            _ => true,
        };
        if matches!(rules[0], Rule::OwnerOrWitness | Rule::OwnerOrIdWitness) && !*owner && matches!(kind, Read::Page | Read::Bounded | Read::Exists) {
            out.push(format!("parent-pinned-grant-{kind:?}").to_lowercase());
        }
        if matches!(kind, Read::Exists) {
            out.push(format!("search-exists-{}", if uniform { "decided" } else { "undecided" }));
        }
        if matches!(kind, Read::Page | Read::Bounded) {
            out.push(format!("{}-{kind:?}", if uniform { "uniform" } else { "non-uniform" }).to_lowercase());
            if uniform && matches!(kind, Read::Page) {
                // C2: whether the binder may keep a residual filter on the scan.
                out.push(format!("uniform-page-{}", if case.program.residual.is_some() { "with-residual" } else { "without-residual" }));
            }
        }
        if let Some(order) = &case.program.order {
            out.push(format!("order-{}", order.join("-")));
        }
        if let Some(residual) = &case.program.residual {
            out.push(format!("residual-{}", residual_name(residual)));
        }
    }
    out
}

/// A stable feature name for a residual conjunct of `generate`.
fn residual_name(residual: &str) -> &'static str {
    match residual {
        ".score >= 0" => "score-ge",
        ".label != ''" => "label-ne",
        ".maybe = null" => "nullable-eq-null",
        ".maybe = n" => "nullable-eq-arg",
        "(.score > 0 or .flag = false)" => "disjunction",
        _ => "other",
    }
}

/// One case, counted into `report`.
pub fn check(case: &Case, report: &mut Report, mut found: impl FnMut(crate::oracle::Finding)) -> Result<(), String> {
    report.generated += 1;
    for feature in crate::coverage::features(case) {
        *report.coverage.entry(feature).or_default() += 1;
    }
    let source = case.program.source();
    if let Err(e) = execute::compile(&source) {
        report.binder_refused_unexpected += 1;
        return Err(format!("binder: {e}"));
    }
    report.compiled += 1;
    let checked = compare(case, &source)?;
    report.executed += checked.executed;
    if let Verdict::Pass = &checked.verdict {
        // What agreed, by outcome class: evidence for the open points.
        *report.store_stats.entry(format!("lean-agreed/{}", checked.class)).or_default() += 1;
    }
    let stats = &mut report.store_stats;
    // @ref LLP 3000.040#25-the-lean-model — calendar evidence is counted where it is compared.
    if case.program.time_arg {
        *stats.entry("lean-calendar-generated".into()).or_default() += 1;
        let class = match &checked.verdict { Verdict::Unsupported(_) => "unsupported", Verdict::Pass => "agreed", Verdict::Disagree(_) => "disagreeing", _ => "other" };
        *stats.entry(format!("lean-calendar-{class}")).or_default() += 1;
    }
    match &checked.verdict {
        Verdict::Unsupported(_) => *stats.entry("lean-unsupported".into()).or_default() += 1,
        _ => {
            *stats.entry("lean-supported".into()).or_default() += 1;
            *stats.entry(format!("lean-supported-{}", if checked.mutation { "mutation" } else { "query" })).or_default() += 1;
            *stats.entry("lean-pages-compared".into()).or_default() += checked.pages;
            if checked.pages > 1 {
                *stats.entry("lean-continued-reads".into()).or_default() += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    if !matches!(checked.verdict, Verdict::Unsupported(_)) {
        let disagreed = matches!(checked.verdict, Verdict::Disagree(_));
        for feature in features(case) {
            *stats.entry(format!("lean-feature/{feature}/compared")).or_default() += 1;
            if disagreed {
                *stats.entry(format!("lean-feature/{feature}/disagreeing")).or_default() += 1;
            }
        }
    }
    report.by_oracle.entry("lean".into()).or_default().record(&checked.verdict);
    if let Verdict::Disagree(f) = checked.verdict {
        found(f);
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn reproduce(case: &Case, source: &str) -> Result<Verdict, String> {
    execute::compile(source).map_err(|e| format!("binder: {e}"))?;
    compare(case, source).map(|c| c.verdict)
}

/// The Lean campaign's case for `seed`: the Stage 1 generator's case, and
/// for about half the seeds a variant aimed at the model's open points
/// (`snapback4/lean/OPEN.md`), from an independent stream so the base case
/// is unchanged:
///
/// - per-effect rules on `items` (R2's named and unnamed update rules, W1–W4
///   precedence between rules, readability and clashes, C8's non-uniform
///   reads), with `online only` so any read rule is admissible;
/// - `access` unreadable to everyone (R1: whether a rule probe sees a row its
///   table hides);
/// - page orders over a nullable, a boolean or a unique id column (V2, V3);
/// - a further domain conjunct: residual filters (C2's lookahead) and a
///   null-valued equality (V5).
///
/// A third independent stream (so the draws above are unchanged) adds the
/// forms the engine decides per caller (OPEN C5, C8):
///
/// - half the unpaged totals become a search `exists` over the same domain
///   (LLP 3000.036 §15.12), which needs no decided rule and so draws every
///   read rule;
/// - a third of `Owner`/`OwnerOrWitness` read rules become
///   `.owner = viewer or exists access[0, viewer]`, a readable grant (§12.1);
///   `OwnerOrWitness` under the always-pinned `.bucket` is the parent-pinned
///   grant (§16.3);
/// - a third of pages and `exists` reads end their domain with a test that
///   reads no row (`exists access[bucket, viewer]`, its negation, `a < b`),
///   which the compiler lowers to an `if` around a returned page (§15.4).
pub fn generate(seed: u64) -> Case {
    use crate::ast::{Read, Rule};
    let mut case = crate::generate::generate(seed);
    unbound(&mut case);
    // Half the widened cases the model cannot run (projections, expiry) are
    // narrowed back into its fragment; the other half stay named unsupported.
    if crate::generate::Rng::new(seed ^ 0x4c45_414e_4e41_5257).next() % 2 == 0 {
        narrow(&mut case);
    }
    let mut extra = crate::generate::Rng::new(seed ^ 0x4c45_414e_4558_5354);
    if let Body::Read { kind: kind @ (Read::Count | Read::Sum | Read::Min | Read::Max), .. } = &mut case.program.body {
        if extra.pick(2) == 0 {
            *kind = Read::Exists;
        }
    }
    variants(&mut case, seed);
    if let Some(effects) = &mut case.program.tables[0].effects {
        if matches!(effects[0], Rule::Owner | Rule::OwnerOrWitness) && extra.pick(3) == 0 {
            effects[0] = Rule::OwnerOrGrant;
        }
    }
    if matches!(case.program.body, Body::Read { kind: Read::Page | Read::Bounded | Read::Exists, .. }) && extra.pick(3) == 0 {
        let guards = ["exists access[bucket, viewer]", "not exists access[bucket, viewer]", "a < b"];
        case.program.guard = Some(guards[extra.pick(3) as usize].to_owned());
    }
    membership_page(&mut case, seed);
    boolean_grant_page(&mut case, seed);
    crate::generate::page3(&mut case);
    crate::generate::page4(&mut case);
    case
}

/// An unpinned owner-or-membership page. Half the rosters retain cap 16 by the
/// fixed principal; half rely on the total unique membership point. Both use
/// the inverse `(principal, bucket)` index for metered discovery before merge.
fn membership_page(case: &mut Case, seed: u64) {
    use crate::ast::{Read, Residency, Rule};
    let mut rng = crate::generate::Rng::new(seed ^ 0x4d45_4d42_4552_5047);
    let inherited_id = case.program.tables.iter().find(|table| table.name == "access")
        .is_some_and(|table| table.columns.iter().any(|column| column.name == "item"));
    let inherited_discovery = case.program.tables.iter().find(|table| table.name == "access")
        .is_some_and(|table| table.keys.iter().any(|(name, _, _)| name == "byPrincipalOnly"));
    if inherited_id || inherited_discovery {
        let read = if inherited_id { Rule::OwnerOrIdWitness } else { Rule::OwnerOrWitness };
        case.program.tables[0].rule = read.clone();
        case.program.tables[0].effects = Some(vec![read, Rule::Allow, Rule::Allow, Rule::Allow]);
        if inherited_id && case.program.guard.as_deref().is_some_and(|guard| guard.contains("access[")) {
            case.program.guard = Some("a < b".into());
        }
        return
    }
    let Body::Read { kind: kind @ (Read::Page | Read::Bounded), filter, owner, project, .. } = &mut case.program.body else { return };
    if rng.pick(8) != 0 { return }
    *kind = Read::Page;
    *filter = false;
    *owner = false;
    *project = None;
    let items = &mut case.program.tables[0];
    let by_id = rng.pick(2) == 0;
    items.rule = if by_id { Rule::OwnerOrIdWitness } else { Rule::OwnerOrWitness };
    items.effects = None;
    items.residency = Residency::Online;
    let access = case.program.tables.iter_mut().find(|table| table.name == "access").expect("generated access table");
    access.rule = Rule::Allow;
    access.effects = None;
    access.residency = Residency::Public;
    if rng.pick(2) == 0 { access.caps.clear(); }
    let discovery_unique = !by_id && access.caps.is_empty() && rng.pick(2) == 0;
    case.program.domain = Some("true".into());
    case.program.order = Some(vec!["id".into()]);
    case.program.residual = None;
    case.program.guard = None;
    case.program.membership_named_reordered = !by_id && rng.pick(2) == 0;
    if by_id { crate::generate::id_membership(case); }
    else if discovery_unique { crate::generate::discovery_unique_membership(case); }
}

/// A readable grant guarded by a required Boolean that the page pins false.
/// This independently exercises guard normalization in native and Lean.
fn boolean_grant_page(case: &mut Case, seed: u64) {
    use crate::ast::{Read, Residency, Rule};
    let mut rng = crate::generate::Rng::new(seed ^ 0x424f_4f4c_4752_4e54);
    let Body::Read { kind: Read::Page | Read::Bounded, filter, owner, project, .. } = &mut case.program.body else { return };
    if rng.pick(16) != 0 { return }
    *filter = false;
    *owner = false;
    *project = None;
    let items = &mut case.program.tables[0];
    items.rule = Rule::OwnerOrGrant;
    items.effects = None;
    items.residency = Residency::Online;
    let access = case.program.tables.iter_mut().find(|table| table.name == "access").expect("generated access table");
    access.rule = Rule::Allow;
    access.effects = None;
    access.residency = Residency::Public;
    case.program.domain = Some(".flag = false".into());
    case.program.order = Some(vec!["id".into()]);
    case.program.residual = None;
    case.program.guard = None;
    case.program.membership_named_reordered = false;
    case.program.boolean_grant_normalized = true;
}

/// The variants of the first two streams (`generate`).
fn variants(case: &mut Case, seed: u64) {
    use crate::ast::{Residency, Rule};
    let mut rng = crate::generate::Rng::new(seed ^ 0x4c45_414e_5641_5249);
    let mut pick = |n: u64| rng.next() % n;
    if pick(2) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    if pick(2) == 0 {
        // An unpaged total needs a read rule its pins decide (`E_QUARRY_BOUND`):
        // `.bucket` is always pinned, `.owner` only when the read pins it.
        let total = matches!(case.program.body, Body::Read { kind: crate::ast::Read::Count | crate::ast::Read::Sum | crate::ast::Read::Min | crate::ast::Read::Max, .. });
        let owner_pinned = matches!(case.program.body, Body::Read { owner: true, .. });
        let reads: &[Rule] = if total && !owner_pinned { &[Rule::Allow, Rule::Witness] } else { &[Rule::Allow, Rule::Owner, Rule::Witness, Rule::OwnerOrWitness] };
        let read = reads[pick(reads.len() as u64) as usize].clone();
        let insert = [Rule::Allow, Rule::Deny, Rule::Owner, Rule::Witness][pick(4) as usize].clone();
        let update = [Rule::Allow, Rule::Deny, Rule::Owner, Rule::Witness, Rule::NamedBoth, Rule::NamedNext, Rule::NamedOld][pick(7) as usize].clone();
        let delete = [Rule::Allow, Rule::Deny, Rule::Owner, Rule::Witness][pick(4) as usize].clone();
        case.program.tables[0].effects = Some(vec![read, insert, update, delete]);
        case.program.tables[0].residency = Residency::Online;
    }
    if pick(4) == 0 {
        case.program.tables[1].effects = Some(vec![Rule::Deny, Rule::Allow, Rule::Allow, Rule::Allow]);
        case.program.tables[1].residency = Residency::Online;
        // A hidden, open roster cannot carry a group audience (`E_SYNC`); the
        // model has no residency, so the group-synced branch shape reads online.
        if matches!(case.program.tables[0].residency, Residency::Group) {
            case.program.tables[0].residency = Residency::Online;
        }
    }
    if matches!(case.program.body, Body::Read { kind: crate::ast::Read::Page | crate::ast::Read::Bounded, .. }) && pick(2) == 0 {
        let orders: [&[&str]; 5] = [&["maybe"], &["maybe", "label"], &["flag", "score"], &["tag"], &["score"]];
        case.program.order = Some(orders[pick(5) as usize].iter().map(|c| c.to_string()).collect());
    }
    if matches!(case.program.body, Body::Read { .. }) && pick(3) == 0 {
        let residuals = [".score >= 0", ".label != ''", ".maybe = null", ".maybe = n", "(.score > 0 or .flag = false)"];
        let residual = residuals[pick(5) as usize];
        // An intrinsic-id lane already pins identity: equality on nullable
        // `maybe` can exhaust its range prefix. Keep this generated variant a
        // row filter so the exact by-id page remains in the admitted fragment.
        let residual = if residual == ".maybe = null" && matches!(case.program.tables[0].rule, Rule::OwnerOrIdWitness) { ".maybe != null" } else { residual };
        case.program.residual = Some(residual.to_owned());
    }
}

/// Remove widened dimensions outside the model's fragment (`widen.rs`): page
/// projections (`shape`) and write TTL expressions. Declared upper lifetimes,
/// seeded expiry values and explicit sweeps stay in the formal comparison.
pub fn narrow(case: &mut Case) {
    use crate::ast::Stmt;
    if let Body::Read { project, .. } = &mut case.program.body {
        *project = None;
    }
    if !matches!(case.program.body, Body::Read { kind: crate::ast::Read::Fold, .. }) {
        // The CUT generator can make tag a live reference used by a residual.
        // Narrow both the predicate and its type before dropping the target.
        for column in &mut case.program.tables[0].columns {
            if matches!(&column.ty, crate::ast::Type::Reference(target) if target == "tags") {
                column.ty = crate::ast::Type::Id;
            }
        }
        if case.program.residual.as_deref().is_some_and(|r| r.contains(".tag.rank")) {
            case.program.residual = None;
        }
        case.program.tables.retain(|t| t.name != "tags");
        case.rows.retain(|(t, _)| t != "tags");
    }
    fn plain(stmts: &mut [Stmt]) {
        for s in stmts {
            match s {
                Stmt::Write { ttl, .. } => *ttl = None,
                Stmt::If(_, a, b) => {
                    plain(a);
                    plain(b);
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
    }
    if let Body::Block(b) = &mut case.program.body {
        plain(&mut b.stmts);
    }
    for b in &mut case.program.prelude {
        plain(&mut b.stmts);
    }
}

/// Slot bounds are outside the model's fragment (LLP 3000.040 §1.8): every
/// Lean case drops them, so the campaign compares the rest of the case.
fn unbound(case: &mut Case) {
    case.program.arg_bound = None;
    for t in &mut case.program.tables {
        for c in &mut t.columns {
            if matches!(c.ty, crate::ast::Type::IntRange(..)) {
                c.ty = crate::ast::Type::Int;
            }
        }
    }
}

pub fn run_bounded(seed: u64, cases: u64, out: &std::path::Path, seconds: Option<f64>) -> Result<Report, String> {
    std::fs::create_dir_all(out).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let started = std::time::Instant::now();
    let mut report = Report { seed, cases, ..Report::default() };
    let mut saved = BTreeSet::new();
    let mut failure = None;
    for i in 0..cases {
        if seconds.is_some_and(|limit| started.elapsed().as_secs_f64() >= limit) {
            report.time_limited_workers = 1;
            break;
        }
        let case_started = std::time::Instant::now();
        let case = generate(seed.wrapping_add(i));
        let mut findings = Vec::new();
        if let Err(error) = check(&case, &mut report, |f| {
            if saved.insert(f.signature.clone()) {
                findings.push(f);
            }
        }) {
            let path = out.join(format!("setup-{}", case.seed));
            std::fs::create_dir_all(&path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            std::fs::write(path.join("case.q"), case.program.source()).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            std::fs::write(path.join("case.json"), serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&case).unwrap()).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            *report.generator_errors.entry(error.clone()).or_default() += 1;
            failure = Some(error);
            break;
        }
        for f in findings {
            let a = crate::shrink::shrink(case.clone(), f);
            crate::shrink::save(&out.join(&a.finding.signature), &a)?;
        }
        let elapsed = case_started.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
        if elapsed > report.slowest_case_seconds {
            report.slowest_case_seconds = elapsed;
            report.slowest_case_seed = Some(case.seed);
        }
        if (i + 1) % 1000 == 0 {
            eprintln!("{} cases in {:.1}s", i + 1, started.elapsed().as_secs_f64());
        }
    }
    report.seconds = started.elapsed().as_secs_f64();
    std::fs::write(out.join("report.json"), serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&report).unwrap()).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    if let Some(error) = failure {
        return Err(error);
    }
    // A campaign large enough to qualify must have compared calendar cases (LLP 3000.040 §2.5).
    let compared = ["lean-calendar-agreed", "lean-calendar-disagreeing"].iter().map(|k| report.store_stats.get(*k).copied().unwrap_or(0)).sum::<u64>();
    if report.generated >= 5_000 && compared == 0 {
        return Err(format!("{} cases compared no calendar case: the calendar dimension was not drawn or not supported", report.generated));
    }
    Ok(report)
}

//! Pause advice covers retained populations without running their activation.
use super::*;
use crate::rows::Rows;

fn open(source: &str) -> Engine {
    let b = compile(source);
    Engine::new_at(Store::memory().unwrap(), b.schema, b.programs, 0).unwrap()
}

fn preview(e: &mut Engine, next: &Schema) -> super::super::adoption_estimate::AdoptionEstimate {
    let before = ["r", "i", "_log", "_commits", "_generations"].map(|t| rows(e, t));
    let generation = e.generation();
    let estimate = e.store_mut().adoption_estimate(next).unwrap().expect("populated write work needs advice");
    assert_eq!(generation, e.generation());
    for (t, old) in ["r", "i", "_log", "_commits", "_generations"].into_iter().zip(before) {
        assert_eq!(rows(e, t), old, "preview wrote {t}");
    }
    estimate
}

const CHILDREN: &str = "table parents:\n  public\ntable children:\n  parent: parents\n  until: time default 50\n  immutable parent\n  expire at .until\n  read through .parent\n";
fn children(source: &str, count: usize) -> Engine {
    let mut e = open(source);
    e.seed_at(std::iter::once(("parents".into(), object([("id", Value::Id("p".into()))])))
        .chain((0..count).map(|n| ("children".into(), object([
            ("id", Value::Id(format!("c{n}"))), ("parent", Value::Id("p".into())), ("until", Value::Int(50)),
        ])))), 0).unwrap();
    e
}

#[test]
fn inherited_expiry_default_warns_before_retiring_one_thousand_children() {
    let mut e = children(CHILDREN, 1000);
    let next = compile(&CHILDREN.replace("default 50", "default 200"));
    let estimate = preview(&mut e, &next.schema);
    assert_eq!(estimate.deadline_rewrite_rows, 0);
    let message = estimate.summary();
    assert!(message.contains("unestimated write pause") && message.contains("read-through retirement/recapture children (1000 stored rows; deletion subset depends on activation time)"), "{message}");
    assert!(!message.contains("to recompute deadlines"), "{message}");
    e.adopt_at(next.schema, next.programs, 100).unwrap();
    assert!(e.store().rows("children").unwrap().is_empty());
    assert_eq!(e.store().conn().query_row("SELECT count(*) FROM i JOIN _catalog c ON c.num=i.ti WHERE c.name LIKE 'children.%'", [], |r| r.get::<_, i64>(0)).unwrap(), 0);
}

#[test]
fn adding_and_removing_read_through_warn_about_predecessor_retirement() {
    let ordinary = CHILDREN.replace("read through .parent", "public");
    for (old, new) in [(ordinary.as_str(), CHILDREN), (CHILDREN, ordinary.as_str())] {
        let mut e = children(old, 3);
        let next = compile(new);
        let estimate = preview(&mut e, &next.schema);
        assert_eq!(estimate.deadline_rewrite_rows, 0);
        let message = estimate.summary();
        assert!(message.contains("read-through retirement/recapture children (3 stored rows; deletion subset depends on activation time)"), "{message}");
        assert!(!message.contains("to recompute deadlines"), "{message}");
        e.adopt_at(next.schema, next.programs, 100).unwrap();
        assert!(e.store().rows("children").unwrap().is_empty());
    }
}

#[test]
fn unchanged_read_through_tables_warn_about_deadline_rewrites_without_retirement() {
    for now in [10, 100] {
        let mut e = children(CHILDREN, 3);
        let next = compile(&format!("{CHILDREN}\ntable unrelated:\n  public\n"));
        let estimate = preview(&mut e, &next.schema);
        assert_eq!(estimate.deadline_rewrite_rows, 3);
        assert_eq!((estimate.retired_rows, estimate.retired_index_entries), (0, 0));
        assert_eq!(estimate.seconds(), (0.0, 0.0)); // No measured rewrite rate.
        let message = estimate.summary();
        assert!(message.contains("unestimated write pause") && message.contains("read-through children rewrites 3 stored rows to recompute deadlines"), "{message}");
        assert!(!message.contains("retirement/recapture") && !message.contains("deletion subset"), "{message}");
        e.adopt_at(next.schema, next.programs, now).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(e.store().rows("children").unwrap().len(), 3);
    }
}

const GROUPS: &str = "table entries:\n  n: int\n  bucket: int\n  public\nview totals: count entries by .n\n";
fn groups() -> Engine {
    let mut e = open(GROUPS);
    e.seed_at((0..4).map(|n| ("entries".into(), object([
        ("id", Value::Id(format!("r{n}"))), ("n", Value::Int(n)), ("bucket", Value::Int(0)),
    ]))), 0).unwrap();
    e
}
fn rebuild_groups(next: &str, remaining: usize) {

}

#[test]
fn missing_identity_marker_rebuilds_a_principal_reference_and_max_text_group() {
    const SOURCE: &str = "table parents:\n  public\ntable entries:\n  owner: principal\n  parent: parents\n  token: text <=64\n  amount: int\n  public\nview totals: sum entries of .amount by .owner, .parent, .token\n  public\n";
    let initial = compile(SOURCE);

    let owner = format!("user:{}", "o".repeat(59));

    let token = "t".repeat(64);
    assert_eq!((owner.len(), parent.len(), token.len()), (64, 64, 64));
    e.seed_at([
        ("parents".into(), object([("id", Value::Id(parent.clone()))])),
        ("entries".into(), object([("id", Value::Id("entry".into())), ("owner", Value::Id(owner.clone())),
            ("parent", Value::Id(parent.clone())), ("token", Value::String(token.clone())), ("amount", Value::Int(7))])),
    ], 0).unwrap();
    let expected = crate::schema::maintained_id(&[Value::Id(owner), Value::Id(parent), Value::String(token)]);

    assert_eq!(after.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(after[0].field("id").unwrap(), &Value::Id(expected));
    assert_eq!(after[0].field("value").unwrap(), &Value::Int(7));

#[test]
fn identity_adoption_rekeys_sequence_history_without_reusing_deleted_ordinals() {
    const SOURCE: &str = "table entries:\n  bucket: int\n  public\nview totals: count entries by .bucket\n  public\ntable sequenced:\n  total: totals\n  ordinal: sequence by total\n  unique total, ordinal\n  public\n";
    let mut e = open(SOURCE);
    e.seed_at([
        ("entries".into(), object([("id", Value::Id("e7".into())), ("bucket", Value::Int(7))])),
        ("entries".into(), object([("id", Value::Id("e9".into())), ("bucket", Value::Int(9))])),
    ], 0).unwrap();
    let digest7 = crate::schema::maintained_id(&[Value::Int(7)]);
    let digest9 = crate::schema::maintained_id(&[Value::Int(9)]);
    e.seed_at([
        ("sequenced".into(), object([("id", Value::Id("gone".into())), ("total", Value::Id(digest7.clone()))])),
        ("sequenced".into(), object([("id", Value::Id("kept".into())), ("total", Value::Id(digest7.clone()))])),
    ], 0).unwrap();
    e.seed_delete("sequenced", "gone").unwrap();

    let legacy7 = crate::value::canonical_json(&[Value::Int(7)]);
    let legacy9 = crate::value::canonical_json(&[Value::Int(9)]);
    let noncanonical7 = "[ { \"Int\" : 7 } ]".to_owned();
    let wrong_type7 = crate::value::canonical_json(&[Value::String("7".into())]);
    let schema = e.schema().clone();
    let target = schema.tables["totals"].clone();
    let entries = schema.tables["entries"].clone();
    let sequenced = schema.tables["sequenced"].clone();
    let tx = e.store_mut().transaction().unwrap();
    let mut row = tx.get("totals", &digest7).unwrap().unwrap();
    tx.delete("totals", &target, &row).unwrap();
    if let Value::Row(fields) | Value::Map(fields) = &mut row {
        fields.insert("id".into(), Value::Id(legacy7.clone()));
    }
    tx.put("totals", &target, &row, None).unwrap();
    tx.delete("totals", &target, &tx.get("totals", &digest9).unwrap().unwrap()).unwrap();
    tx.delete("entries", &entries, &tx.get("entries", "e9").unwrap().unwrap()).unwrap();
    let old = tx.get("sequenced", "kept").unwrap().unwrap();
    let mut next = old.clone();
    if let Value::Row(fields) | Value::Map(fields) = &mut next {
        fields.insert("total".into(), Value::Id(legacy7.clone()));
    }
    tx.put("sequenced", &sequenced, &next, Some(&old)).unwrap();
    tx.set_sequence("totals", &legacy7, 7).unwrap();
    tx.set_sequence("totals", &digest7, 4).unwrap();
    tx.set_sequence("totals", &legacy9, crate::value::I53_MAX).unwrap();
    tx.set_sequence("totals", &digest9, 12).unwrap();
    tx.set_sequence("totals", &noncanonical7, 13).unwrap();
    tx.set_sequence("totals", &wrong_type7, 14).unwrap();
    tx.set_sequence("ordinary", &legacy7, 11).unwrap();
    tx.commit().unwrap();
    e.store().conn().execute("DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key=?1", [crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_META]).unwrap();

    let next = compile(SOURCE);
    e.adopt_at(next.schema, next.programs, 1).unwrap();
    let tx = e.store_mut().transaction().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("totals", &legacy7).unwrap(), 0);
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("totals", &legacy9).unwrap(), 0);
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("totals", &digest7).unwrap(), 7, "the deleted allocating row and lower destination counter cannot lower the high-water mark");
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("totals", &digest9).unwrap(), crate::value::I53_MAX);
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("totals", &noncanonical7).unwrap(), 13, "a noncanonical dangling id must not collapse into the real group");
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("totals", &wrong_type7).unwrap(), 14, "a canonical tuple with the wrong predecessor type stays opaque");
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("ordinary", &legacy7).unwrap(), 11, "translation is scoped by parent table and id");
    tx.commit().unwrap();
    let kept = e.store().rows("sequenced").unwrap().pop().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(kept.field("total").unwrap(), &Value::Id(digest7.clone()));
    assert_eq!(kept.field("ordinal").unwrap(), &Value::Int(2));

    e.seed_at([("sequenced".into(), object([("id", Value::Id("next".into())), ("total", Value::Id(digest7))]))], 2).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(e.store().rows("sequenced").unwrap().into_iter().find(|row| row.field("id") == Ok(&Value::Id("next".into()))).unwrap().field("ordinal"), Ok(&Value::Int(8)));
    let error = e.seed_at([("sequenced".into(), object([("id", Value::Id("full".into())), ("total", Value::Id(digest9.clone()))]))], 2).unwrap_err();
    assert_eq!(error.refusal().code, "E_SEQUENCE_EXHAUSTED");
    let tx = e.store_mut().transaction().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("totals", &digest9).unwrap(), crate::value::I53_MAX, "overflow refusal must not change the migrated counter");
    tx.rollback().unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn removing_an_aggregate_normalizes_retained_sequence_custody_before_marking_the_store() {
    const SOURCE: &str = "table entries:\n  bucket: int\n  public\nview totals: count entries by .bucket\n  public\ntable sequenced:\n  total: totals\n  ordinal: sequence by total\n  unique total, ordinal\n  public\n";
    const WITHOUT_AGGREGATE: &str = "table entries:\n  bucket: int\n  public\n";
    let mut e = open(SOURCE);
    e.seed_at([("entries".into(), object([("id", Value::Id("entry".into())), ("bucket", Value::Int(3))]))], 0).unwrap();
    let digest = crate::schema::maintained_id(&[Value::Int(3)]);
    let legacy = crate::value::canonical_json(&[Value::Int(3)]);
    let target = e.schema().tables["totals"].clone();
    let tx = e.store_mut().transaction().unwrap();
    let mut row = tx.get("totals", &digest).unwrap().unwrap();
    tx.delete("totals", &target, &row).unwrap();
    if let Value::Row(fields) | Value::Map(fields) = &mut row {
        fields.insert("id".into(), Value::Id(legacy.clone()));
    }
    tx.put("totals", &target, &row, None).unwrap();
    tx.set_sequence("totals", &legacy, 5).unwrap();
    tx.commit().unwrap();
    e.store().conn().execute("DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key=?1", [crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_META]).unwrap();

    let removed = compile(WITHOUT_AGGREGATE);
    e.adopt_at(removed.schema, removed.programs, 1).unwrap();
    let tx = e.store_mut().transaction().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("totals", &legacy).unwrap(), 0);
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("totals", &digest).unwrap(), 5);
    tx.commit().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(e.store().meta(crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_META).unwrap().as_deref(), Some(crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_VERSION));

    let restored = compile(SOURCE);
    e.adopt_at(restored.schema, restored.programs, 2).unwrap();
    e.seed_at([("sequenced".into(), object([("id", Value::Id("next".into())), ("total", Value::Id(digest))]))], 3).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(e.store().rows("sequenced").unwrap()[0].field("ordinal"), Ok(&Value::Int(6)));
}

#[test]
fn counter_only_aggregate_reference_chains_rekey_to_the_final_digest() {
    const SOURCE: &str = "table aEntries:\n  key: int\n  public\nview aTotals: count aEntries by .key\n  public\ntable bEntries:\n  parent: aTotals\n  public\nview bTotals: count bEntries by .parent\n  public\ntable sequenced:\n  parent: bTotals\n  ordinal: sequence by parent\n  public\n";
    let mut e = open(SOURCE);
    let legacy_a = crate::value::canonical_json(&[Value::Int(5)]);
    let legacy_b = crate::value::canonical_json(&[Value::Id(legacy_a.clone())]);
    let digest_a = crate::schema::maintained_id(&[Value::Int(5)]);
    let digest_b = crate::schema::maintained_id(&[Value::Id(digest_a)]);
    let tx = e.store_mut().transaction().unwrap();
    tx.set_sequence("bTotals", &legacy_b, 9).unwrap();
    tx.commit().unwrap();
    e.store().conn().execute("DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key=?1", [crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_META]).unwrap();

    let next = compile(SOURCE);
    e.adopt_at(next.schema, next.programs, 1).unwrap();
    let tx = e.store_mut().transaction().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("bTotals", &legacy_b).unwrap(), 0);
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("bTotals", &digest_b).unwrap(), 9, "the absent referenced aggregate identity must settle before its dependent counter key");
    tx.rollback().unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn surviving_aggregate_identity_wins_over_a_counter_only_dependency() {
    const SOURCE: &str = "table aEntries:\n  key: int\n  public\nview aTotals: count aEntries by .key\n  public\ntable bEntries:\n  parent: aTotals\n  public\nview bTotals: count bEntries by .parent\n  public\ntable cEntries:\n  parent: bTotals\n  public\nview cTotals: count cEntries by .parent\n  public\ntable sequenced:\n  parent: bTotals\n  ordinal: sequence by parent\n  public\n";
    let mut e = open(SOURCE);
    let digest_a = crate::schema::maintained_id(&[Value::Int(5)]);
    e.seed_at([
        ("aEntries".into(), object([("id", Value::Id("a".into())), ("key", Value::Int(5))])),
        ("bEntries".into(), object([("id", Value::Id("b".into())), ("parent", Value::Id(digest_a.clone()))])),
    ], 0).unwrap();
    let legacy_a = crate::value::canonical_json(&[Value::Int(5)]);
    let digest_b = crate::schema::maintained_id(&[Value::Id(digest_a.clone())]);
    let legacy_b = crate::value::canonical_json(&[Value::Id(legacy_a.clone())]);
    let dangling_b = crate::schema::maintained_id(&[Value::Id(legacy_a.clone())]);
    let legacy_c = crate::value::canonical_json(&[Value::Id(legacy_b.clone())]);
    let digest_c = crate::schema::maintained_id(&[Value::Id(dangling_b.clone())]);
    let redirected_c = crate::schema::maintained_id(&[Value::Id(digest_b.clone())]);
    let schema = e.schema().clone();
    let tx = e.store_mut().transaction().unwrap();
    tx.delete("aTotals", &schema.tables["aTotals"], &tx.get("aTotals", &digest_a).unwrap().unwrap()).unwrap();
    tx.delete("aEntries", &schema.tables["aEntries"], &tx.get("aEntries", "a").unwrap().unwrap()).unwrap();
    let old_source = tx.get("bEntries", "b").unwrap().unwrap();
    let mut next_source = old_source.clone();
    if let Value::Row(fields) | Value::Map(fields) = &mut next_source {
        fields.insert("parent".into(), Value::Id(legacy_a.clone()));
    }
    tx.put("bEntries", &schema.tables["bEntries"], &next_source, Some(&old_source)).unwrap();
    let mut target = tx.get("bTotals", &digest_b).unwrap().unwrap();
    tx.delete("bTotals", &schema.tables["bTotals"], &target).unwrap();
    if let Value::Row(fields) | Value::Map(fields) = &mut target {
        fields.insert("id".into(), Value::Id(legacy_b.clone()));
        fields.insert("parent".into(), Value::Id(legacy_a.clone()));
    }
    tx.put("bTotals", &schema.tables["bTotals"], &target, None).unwrap();
    tx.set_sequence("bTotals", &legacy_b, 7).unwrap();
    tx.set_sequence("cTotals", &legacy_c, 11).unwrap();
    tx.commit().unwrap();
    e.store().conn().execute("DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key=?1", [crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_META]).unwrap();

    let next = compile(SOURCE);
    e.adopt_at(next.schema, next.programs, 1).unwrap();
    let tx = e.store_mut().transaction().unwrap();
    assert!(tx.get("bTotals", &dangling_b).unwrap().is_some());
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("bTotals", &legacy_b).unwrap(), 0);
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("bTotals", &dangling_b).unwrap(), 7, "counter custody follows the surviving rebuilt parent");
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("bTotals", &digest_b).unwrap(), 0, "the absent dependency cannot redirect custody");
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("cTotals", &legacy_c).unwrap(), 0);
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("cTotals", &digest_c).unwrap(), 11, "counter-only dependents inherit the authoritative surviving parent map");
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("cTotals", &redirected_c).unwrap(), 0);
    tx.rollback().unwrap();
    e.seed_at([("sequenced".into(), object([("id", Value::Id("next".into())), ("parent", Value::Id(dangling_b))]))], 2).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(e.store().rows("sequenced").unwrap()[0].field("ordinal"), Ok(&Value::Int(8)));
}

#[test]
fn sequence_identity_rekey_rolls_back_with_the_adoption_writer() {
    let mut store = Store::memory().unwrap();
    let legacy = crate::value::canonical_json(&[Value::Int(7)]);
    let digest = crate::schema::maintained_id(&[Value::Int(7)]);
    let tx = store.transaction().unwrap();
    tx.set_sequence("totals", &legacy, 11).unwrap();
    tx.commit().unwrap();

    let tx = store.transaction().unwrap();
    tx.rewrite_sequence_ids(&BTreeMap::from([(
        "totals".into(),
        BTreeMap::from([(legacy.clone(), digest.clone())]),
    )])).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("totals", &legacy).unwrap(), 0);
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("totals", &digest).unwrap(), 11);
    tx.rollback().unwrap();

    let tx = store.transaction().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("totals", &legacy).unwrap(), 11);
    assert_eq!(tx.sequence_value("totals", &digest).unwrap(), 0);
    tx.rollback().unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn legacy_identity_adoption_can_change_the_grouping_key() {
    let mut e = groups();
    let schema = e.schema().clone();
    let target = schema.tables["totals"].clone();
    let rows = e.store().rows("totals").unwrap();
    let tx = e.store_mut().transaction().unwrap();
    for old in rows {
        tx.delete("totals", &target, &old).unwrap();
        let mut legacy = old.clone();
        let id = crate::value::canonical_json(&[old.field("n").unwrap().clone()]);
        if let Value::Row(fields) | Value::Map(fields) = &mut legacy {
            fields.insert("id".into(), Value::Id(id));
        }
        tx.put("totals", &target, &legacy, None).unwrap();
    }
    tx.commit().unwrap();
    e.store().conn().execute(
        "DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key=?1",
        [crate::schema::MAINTAINED_ID_META],
    ).unwrap();

    let next = compile(&GROUPS.replace("by .n", "by .bucket"));
    e.adopt_at(next.schema, next.programs, 10).unwrap();
    let rows = e.store().rows("totals").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(rows.len(), 1);
    assert_eq!(rows[0].field("id").unwrap(),
        &Value::Id(crate::schema::maintained_id(&[Value::Int(0)])));
    assert_eq!(rows[0].field("bucket").unwrap(), &Value::Int(0));
    assert_eq!(rows[0].field("value").unwrap(), &Value::Int(4));
}
#[test]
fn empty_source_does_not_hide_retained_target_cleanup() {
    let mut e = groups();
    // A legacy/imported target may outlive its source population.
    e.store().conn().execute_batch("DELETE FROM r WHERE t=(SELECT num FROM _catalog WHERE name='entries'); DELETE FROM i WHERE ti IN (SELECT num FROM _catalog WHERE name LIKE 'entries.%');").unwrap();
    let next = compile(&GROUPS.replace("count entries by", "count entries where .n < 0 by"));
    let estimate = preview(&mut e, &next.schema);
    assert_eq!(estimate.aggregate_rows, 0);
    assert_eq!(estimate.retired_rows, 4);
    e.adopt_at(next.schema, next.programs, 10).unwrap();
    assert!(e.store().rows("totals").unwrap().is_empty());
}

#[test]
fn parent_lifetime_change_warns_about_mirror_without_private_rebuild() {
    let source = "table posts:\n  until: time default 50\n  expire at .until\n  likes: count likes by postId\n  public\ntable likes:\n  postId: posts\n  public\n";
    let mut e = open(source);
    e.seed_at([("posts".into(), object([("id", Value::Id("p".into())), ("until", Value::Int(50))]))], 0).unwrap();
    let next = compile(&source.replace("default 50", "default 200"));
    assert!(!crate::successor::maintain_rebuild_needed(e.schema(), &next.schema, &next.schema.maintains[0]));

}

    let mut e = open(source);
    e.seed_at([("entries".into(), object([("id", Value::Id("e".into())), ("n", Value::Int(0)), ("until", Value::Int(50))]))], 0).unwrap();
    let next = compile(&format!("{source}\ntable unrelated:\n  public\n"));
    let message = preview(&mut e, &next.schema).summary();
    assert!(message.contains("cap occupancy reset/rebuild (1 stored entries, 1 source rows)"), "{message}");

    e.store().conn().execute("DELETE FROM _meta WHERE key='cap_counts_schema'", []).unwrap();
    let same = e.schema().clone();

}

#[test]
fn row_view_rebuild_counts_retained_recount_and_basis_rows() {
    const SOURCE: &str = include_str!("../../../../snapback4-lang/tests/fixtures/row-keyed-view.q");
    for count in [1, 1100] {
        let mut e = open(SOURCE.split("view unread:").next().unwrap());
        let mut input = vec![("members".into(), crate::wire::row_from_json(&e.schema().tables["members"],
            &serde_json::json!({"id":"m","conversationId":"c","principal":"bob","readUpTo":0,"joinedAt":0})).unwrap())];
        input.extend((1..=count).map(|n| ("messages".into(), crate::wire::row_from_json(&e.schema().tables["messages"],
            &serde_json::json!({"id":format!("r{n:04}"),"conversationId":"c","ordinal":n,"senderId":"alice","tombstone":false,"until":1000})).unwrap())));
        e.seed_at(input, 0).unwrap();
        let bound = compile(SOURCE);
        e.adopt_at(bound.schema, bound.programs, 1).unwrap();
        let hidden = if count == 1 { "$basis:unread" } else { "$recount:unread" };
        assert!(!e.store().rows(hidden).unwrap().is_empty(), "{hidden}");
        let rows: i64 = e.store().conn().query_row("SELECT count(*) FROM r JOIN _catalog c ON c.num=r.t WHERE c.name IN ('unread','$basis:unread','$recount:unread')", [], |r| r.get(0)).unwrap();
        let next = compile(&SOURCE.replace("and not .tombstone", "and .tombstone"));
        let estimate = preview(&mut e, &next.schema);
        assert_eq!(estimate.retired_rows, rows as u64);
        assert!(!estimate.summary().contains("$basis:") && !estimate.summary().contains("$recount:"));
        e.adopt_at(next.schema, next.programs, 2).unwrap();
    }
}

mod common;
use snapback4_device::{device::{Backend, Device}, memory::MemoryStore, opening::Opening, call};
use snapback4_core::schema::{Schema, ColumnType, Index, public_table};
use serde_json::json;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use snapback4_device::store::{DeviceStore, DeviceTx};
use snapback4_core::{error::RuntimeError, rows::Rows, value::{Value, object}};

fn plain() -> Backend {
    Backend { generation: 1, programs: vec![], schema: Schema {
        tables: BTreeMap::from([("t".into(), public_table(
            BTreeMap::from([("id".into(), ColumnType::Id)]),
            BTreeMap::from([("byId".into(), Index::of(&["id"], true))]),
        ))]),
        ..Schema::default()
    } }
}

#[test]
fn future_capability_refuses_initial_install_and_adoption_without_changes() {
    let backend = plain();
    for wire in [serde_json::to_value(&backend).unwrap(), json!({"initial_backend":backend})] {
        Opening::parse(Some(&wire.to_string())).unwrap().open(MemoryStore::new()).unwrap();
    }
    let mut future = serde_json::to_value(&backend).unwrap();
    future["generation"] = json!(2);
    future["schema"]["tables"]["t"]["constraints"] = json!([{"Capabilities":["future-derivation"]}]);
    for wire in [future.clone(), json!({"initial_backend":future.clone()})] {
        let error = match Opening::parse(Some(&wire.to_string())) {
            Err(error) => error,
            Ok(_) => panic!("unsupported initial backend accepted"),
        };
        assert_eq!(error.code(), "E_SCHEMA_CAPABILITY");
        assert_eq!(error.family(), "schema");
    }
    let mut device = Device::open_store(MemoryStore::new(), Some(backend)).unwrap();
    device.store().drain();
    let before = call::call(&mut device, json!({"op":"backend"}));
    let answer = call::call(&mut device, json!({"op":"adopt","backend":future}));
    assert_eq!(answer["denied"]["code"], "E_SCHEMA_CAPABILITY");
    assert!(device.store().drain().is_empty());
    assert_eq!(call::call(&mut device, json!({"op":"backend"})), before);
}

#[test]
fn legacy_semantic_backend_is_server_adoptable_but_device_refused() {
    for (capability, source) in [
        ("maintained-id-sha256-v1", "table entries:\n  group: text <=64\n  public\nview totals: count entries by .group\n  public\n"),
        ("expiry-reference-actions-v1", "table parents:\n  until: time ?\n  expire at .until\n  public\ntable children:\n  parent: parents on delete cascade\n  cap 1 by parent\n  public\n"),
    ] {
        let bound = snapback4_lang::compile(&[("schema.q".into(), source.into())]);
        assert!(bound.diagnostics.is_empty(), "{:#?}", bound.diagnostics);
        let backend = Backend { generation: 1, schema: bound.schema, programs: bound.programs.into_iter().map(|program| program.program).collect() };
        let mut legacy = serde_json::to_value(&backend).unwrap();
        for table in legacy["schema"]["tables"].as_object_mut().unwrap().values_mut() {
            for constraint in table["constraints"].as_array_mut().unwrap() {
                if let Some(names) = constraint.get_mut("Capabilities").and_then(|value| value.as_array_mut()) {
                    names.retain(|value| value != capability);
                }
            }
        }
        let adopted: Schema = serde_json::from_value(legacy["schema"].clone()).unwrap();
        assert!(adopted.legacy_semantic_capabilities.contains(capability));
        assert!(serde_json::to_string(&adopted).unwrap().contains(capability));
        let opening = Opening::parse(Some(&legacy.to_string())).expect("legacy bytes remain decodable for store migration");
        let error = match opening.open(MemoryStore::new()) {
            Err(error) => error,
            Ok(_) => panic!("device executed backend missing {capability}"),
        };
        assert_eq!(error.code(), "E_SCHEMA_CAPABILITY");
        assert!(error.to_string().contains(capability), "{error}");
    }
}

fn legacy_digest_store<S: DeviceStore>(store: &mut S) -> Backend {
    let source = "table entries:\n  group: text <=64\n  public\nview totals: count entries by .group\n  public\n";
    let bound = snapback4_lang::compile(&[("schema.q".into(), source.into())]);
    assert!(bound.diagnostics.is_empty(), "{:#?}", bound.diagnostics);
    let mut current = Backend { generation: 2, schema: bound.schema, programs: bound.programs.into_iter().map(|program| program.program).collect() };
    let mut legacy = serde_json::to_value(&current).unwrap();
    legacy["generation"] = json!(1);
    for table in legacy["schema"]["tables"].as_object_mut().unwrap().values_mut() {
        for constraint in table["constraints"].as_array_mut().unwrap() {
            if let Some(names) = constraint.get_mut("Capabilities").and_then(|value| value.as_array_mut()) {
                names.retain(|value| value != "maintained-id-sha256-v1");
            }
        }
    }
    let old: Backend = serde_json::from_value(legacy.clone()).unwrap();
    store.install(&old.schema, &BTreeMap::from([
        ("device:backend".into(), legacy.to_string()),
        ("device:generation".into(), "1".into()),
    ]), false).unwrap();
    let tx = store.transaction().unwrap();
    tx.outbox_insert(1, "pending", r#"{"id":"pending","seq":1,"op":"write","args":{},"new_ids":[]}"#).unwrap();
    tx.commit().unwrap();
    current.generation = 2;
    current
}

fn legacy_digest_recovery<S: DeviceStore>(store: &mut S, initial: bool) {
    let current = legacy_digest_store(store);
    let error = match Opening::Kept.open(Borrowed(store)) {
        Err(error) => error,
        Ok(_) => panic!("offline device executed a kept pre-digest backend"),
    };
    assert_eq!(error.code(), "E_SCHEMA_CAPABILITY");
    let tx = store.transaction().unwrap();
    let before = tx.outbox_entries().unwrap();
    tx.commit().unwrap();
    let opening = if initial { Opening::Initial(current) } else { Opening::Install(current) };
    drop(opening.open(Borrowed(store)).expect("a current backend must recover a kept legacy backend"));
    let tx = store.transaction().unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tx.outbox_entries().unwrap(), before, "semantic upgrade preserves queued writes");
    assert_eq!(tx.meta("device:generation").unwrap().as_deref(), Some("2"));
    tx.commit().unwrap();
}

#[test]
fn current_backend_recovers_kept_legacy_semantics_memory() {
    for initial in [false, true] {
        legacy_digest_recovery(&mut MemoryStore::new(), initial);
    }
}

#[test]
fn current_backend_recovers_kept_legacy_semantics_sqlite() {
    for initial in [false, true] {
        let host = common::Sqlite::new(if initial { "legacy-semantic-initial" } else { "legacy-semantic-install" });
        legacy_digest_recovery(&mut snapback4_core::store::Store::open(&host.path("device")).unwrap(), initial);
    }
}

// Borrow the real store so a refused opening leaves it available for inspection.
struct Borrowed<'a, S>(&'a mut S);
impl<S: DeviceStore> DeviceStore for Borrowed<'_, S> {
    type Tx<'a> = S::Tx<'a> where Self: 'a;
    fn install(&mut self, schema: &Schema, metadata: &BTreeMap<String, String>, reset: bool) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        self.0.install(schema, metadata, reset)
    }
    fn install_checked(&mut self, schema: &Schema, metadata: &BTreeMap<String, String>, reset: bool, expected: &BTreeMap<String, Option<String>>) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> {
        self.0.install_checked(schema, metadata, reset, expected)
    }
    fn meta(&self, key: &str) -> Result<Option<String>, RuntimeError> { self.0.meta(key) }
    fn set_meta(&mut self, key: &str, value: &str) -> Result<(), RuntimeError> { self.0.set_meta(key, value) }
    fn transaction(&mut self) -> Result<Self::Tx<'_>, RuntimeError> { self.0.transaction() }
}

fn refused_reopen_preserves<S: DeviceStore>(store: &mut S) {
    let backend = plain();
    drop(Device::open_store(Borrowed(store), Some(backend.clone())).unwrap());
    let row = object([("id", Value::Id("kept".into()))]);
    let tx = store.transaction().unwrap();
    tx.put("t", &backend.schema.tables["t"], &row, None).unwrap();
    tx.commit().unwrap();
    let mut future = serde_json::to_value(&backend).unwrap();
    future["schema"]["tables"]["t"]["constraints"] = json!([{"Capabilities":["future-derivation"]}]);
    store.set_meta("device:backend", &future.to_string()).unwrap();
    let mut replacement = backend;
    replacement.generation = 2; // Without the fence this resets the held row.
    let before = store.transaction().unwrap().meta_prefix("").unwrap();
    for opening in [Opening::Install(replacement.clone()), Opening::Kept, Opening::Initial(replacement)] {
        let error = match opening.open(Borrowed(store)) {
            Err(error) => error,
            Ok(_) => panic!("unsupported kept backend accepted during reopening"),
        };
        assert_eq!(error.code(), "E_SCHEMA_CAPABILITY");
        let tx = store.transaction().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(tx.meta_prefix("").unwrap(), before, "refusal must preserve all metadata");
        assert_eq!(tx.get("t", "kept").unwrap(), Some(row.clone()), "refusal must preserve rows");
    }
}

#[test]
fn explicit_backend_reopening_checks_kept_capabilities_memory() {
    let mut store = MemoryStore::new();
    refused_reopen_preserves(&mut store);
    // Setup is the only source of writes; refused openings cannot delete anything.
    assert!(store.drain().iter().all(|change| change.v.is_some()));
}
